notes: Unlimited-OCR_int8.litertlm of litert-community/Unlimited-OCR: baidu/Unlimited-OCR (MIT; a 3.3B OCR model: the DeepEncoder vision tower, SAM ViT-B and CLIP-L with a projector, and a 12-layer DeepSeek-V2 mixture-of-experts decoder) converted to LiteRT-LM as a fast_vlm bundle that reads one 1,024 x 1,024 page per request and writes the page as layout blocks (label, box, content). Published 2026-11-15 (Hub main d1907308 at the read of 2026-11-16). Measured on the published bytes (the phone's run batches p11c to p11g). Work dir.
quantization: the text decoder (12 layers: the first dense, then 11 mixture-of-experts layers of 64 routed experts, 6 per token, and 2 shared; all 64 routed experts computed as two fully connected ops, the 6 the router picks kept) with dynamic INT8 channelwise weights in its linear layers (the position table stays float) and FP32 activations declared for the GPU; an INT8 embedding table in its own graph; the decoder's and the embedding's weights in external-weights sections of the file; the vision encoder (SAM ViT-B and CLIP-L) and projector with FP16 weights; a 4,096-token context; a KV cache of 405 slots (the 277 prompt positions stay, and a ring holds the last 128 generated positions); signatures prefill_278 and decode; one 1,024 x 1,024 page per request

output_match = every case passes the line registered before any number of this file: the bar (the 19 cases and thresholds of the Unlimited-OCR-2 conversion, the text normalisation fitted to this model's output): against the original model's fp32 reading (baidu/Unlimited-OCR at 8249d20b in transformers, one 1,024 x 1,024 view per page, greedy with its windowed no-repeat rule 35 / 128), on the text without the block labels and boxes: character error rate <= 0.02 for text, <= 0.05 for photos and pages, 18 of 20 table cells, the same LaTeX for formulas, every receipt field the original finds, an end-of-sequence stop on every reply, and for the 3-page document (one page per request) the three replies together within 0.05 of the original's 3-page reading; and the near-tie rule (registered with the bar before any number of this file): a miss does not count when, at the first token where the reply leaves the original's, the original's top-1 and top-2 logits differ by less than 0.1, the file took the original's second token, and a re-run of the original with 4 threads instead of 12 writes the original's token again

result: 19 of 19 cases pass the registered line, 16 of 19 the bar alone (the card's Correctness table counts the bar alone); misses under the bar: dense_equations (CER 0.0762; first different token 253, the original's top-1 - top-2 = 0.031 logit, the file took the original's second token; a near tie, not counted); doc_receipt (CER 0.1601; first different token 23, the original's top-1 - top-2 = 0.0666 logit, the file took the original's second token; a near tie, not counted); handwrite_formula (CER 0.4191; first different token 23, the original's top-1 - top-2 = 0.0038 logit, the file took the original's second token; a near tie, not counted)
